command:
set -euo pipefail
cd /tmp

echo "== verify staged inputs against their pinned sha256 =="
{ printf '%s  %s\n' 9b43da92651b35814597af6a8b18f500b768679a49fa4678224f384917ce7668 ensembl116_pep.fa.gz
  printf '%s  %s\n' 6b43cff7568a5dead256262b159fe4b1d7fd7f97128efbcc8613d4dbedaacfa9 queries20.fa
} > pins.sha256
sha256sum -c pins.sha256

# makeblastdb cannot read gzip. gzip is a base-image utility, not a second
# scientific tool: makeblastdb and blastp are both BLAST+, so this is one tool.
gzip -dc ensembl116_pep.fa.gz > pep.fa

echo "== makeblastdb: Ensembl 116 human proteome =="
makeblastdb -in pep.fa -dbtype prot -out pepdb -title ensembl116_pep
blastdbcmd -db pepdb -info > dbinfo.txt
cat dbinfo.txt

echo "== blastp: 20 queries vs the whole proteome =="
blastp -query queries20.fa -db pepdb \
  -outfmt '6 qseqid sseqid pident length qlen evalue bitscore' \
  -max_target_seqs 20 -num_threads 8 -out hits.tsv

# ---- smoke check ----
# The queries ARE the first 20 records of the database, so each one must find
# itself: a full-length alignment at 100.000% identity that nothing else beats on
# bitscore. That is a property of the algorithm, not of a measured threshold, so
# these are exact assertions rather than bands.
#
# Note what is NOT asserted: that the self-hit comes FIRST. Measured on this input,
# one query's self-hit ranks second — tied on bitscore and e-value with a paralog,
# and BLAST breaks such ties arbitrarily. "Best hit is itself" would be a flaky
# check; "nothing beats itself" is the same claim stated correctly.
DBSEQS=$(awk '/sequences;/ {gsub(/,/,"",$1); print $1; exit}' dbinfo.txt)
ROWS=$(wc -l < hits.tsv | tr -d ' ')
QWITHHITS=$(cut -f1 hits.tsv | sort -u | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
SELFHITS=$(awk -F'\t' '$1==$2 && $3==100.000 && $4==$5 {print $1}' hits.tsv | sort -u | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
BEATEN=$(awk -F'\t' '{if($1==$2) self[$1]=$7; else if($7>best[$1]) best[$1]=$7}
                     END{n=0; for(q in self) if(best[q]>self[q]) n++; print n}' hits.tsv)
WORST_SELF_E=$(awk -F'\t' '$1==$2 {print $6}' hits.tsv | sort -g | tail -1)

{
  echo "db_sequences            $DBSEQS        want exactly 382428"
  echo "hit_rows                $ROWS          want 300..400        (observed 400)"
  echo "queries_with_any_hit    $QWITHHITS     want exactly 20"
  echo "full_length_self_hits   $SELFHITS      want exactly 20"
  echo "self_hit_beaten_by_other $BEATEN       want exactly 0"
  echo "worst_self_hit_evalue   $WORST_SELF_E  (observed 1.10e-76; informational)"
} > smoke-check.txt
cat smoke-check.txt

test "$DBSEQS"    -eq 382428
test "$ROWS"      -ge 300
test "$ROWS"      -le 400
test "$QWITHHITS" -eq 20
test "$SELFHITS"  -eq 20
test "$BEATEN"    -eq 0
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
